items.summary: arXiv:2602.21869v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Networks underpin systems that range from finance to biology, yet their structure is often only partially observed. Current reconstruction methods typically fit the parameters of a model anew to each snapshot, thus offering no guidance to predict future configurations.
